encode_image_mtm: encode an image using the HomeRobotMTMEncoder to get a visual embedding vector
encode_text_mtm: encode a text string using the HomeRobotMTMEncoder to get a text embedding vector
load_vc_model: load a VC model by name from config YAML files using the load_vc function
test_mtm_encoder: test the HomeRobotMTMEncoder by encoding a random image and text string
tokenize_clip_texts: tokenize text strings using the ClipTokenizerWrapper with CLIP truncation
